To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the ground state of an asymmetric quantum Hall bilayer system at filling ν = 4 / 11 can be described by a Halperin-like state with an additional phase factor in the wave function; (2) the phase factor is a function of the charge distribution imbalance between the layers; (3) the charge imbalance in turn can be controlled by a bias gate.
the ground state of a fractional quantum Hall bilayer system can be described by a Halperin-like wavefunction with an additional charge imbalance parameter.
the ground state of an imbalanced bilayer at filling factor ν=4/11 is a Halperin-like state with a finite charge imbalance.

the physics of the fractional quantum Hall states in the presence of charge asymmetry in the bilayer system.
the fractional quantum Hall states in asymmetric bilayer system.
the fractional quantum Hall state in a bilayer system with charge imbalance, which is induced, for example, by a gate voltage.
